preregistered_read_applied.rule_as_written: a rise means the search was time-bound; a second flat means neither probability mass (v9) nor time (v10) was binding - the bottleneck is candidate QUALITY and further budget levers are ruled out
preregistered_read_applied.conclusion: Two clean single-variable nulls in a row. The DFS search, given 63% more probability mass and 50% more time, returns the same ~4/240. The truth is usually not in the candidate set at any affordable budget - candidate GENERATION quality (augmentation strategy, adapter rank/training, candidate ordering) is the binding constraint. That is a multi-week solver program, not a lever.

strategic_consequence: With the Sept-1 ~10% bar requiring ~4x hit rate and budget levers exhausted, leaderboard climbing is formally deprioritized: ARC's role in the company story is the harness, the incident discipline, the paper track (Nov 8), and the honest 'proving ground' framing - consistent with public rank ~983, which the materials never contradicted. GPU quota stays allocated to the enterprise gates.
